title: Correct final answer
description: Essential: The response must give the final numerical answer as -5 V (or -5 volts).

title: Correct potential difference formula
description: Important: The response must apply the formula for potential difference in a uniform field, U = E * d, where d is the parallel displacement.

title: Correct parallel displacement
description: Important: The response must correctly calculate the displacement along the field direction as d = L * cos(60°).

title: Sign convention for U_BA
description: Important: The response must relate U_BA to U_AB using U_BA = -U_AB.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The response should show consistent unit conversion (e.g., cm to m) or explicitly include units in the final answer.

title: Incorrect angle usage
description: Pitfall: Using sine instead of cosine for the parallel displacement (e.g., d = L * sin(60°)).

title: Sign error
description: Pitfall: Forgetting the negative sign in U_BA = -U_AB, resulting in an answer of +5 V.

title: Unit conversion error
description: Pitfall: Failing to convert the 10 cm distance to meters, leading to an answer off by a factor of 100.
